sentence: Her friends would not help, so the hen planted the little grains herself.
The wheat grew tall. In summer, it was golden and ready to gather.
The little red hen mixed her flour into bread dough. She pushed and folded the dough.
The hen baked her bread.
When she kissed the petals, the flower opened. A tiny girl was sitting inside!
One night, a mother toad carried Thumbelina away.
A fish heard Thumbelina crying. It nibbled the stem under her lily leaf.
A kind field mouse invited her inside.
Then the swallow returned to help her escape. Thumbelina climbed onto his back. Together, they flew south to warmer lands.
There she met a king who was tiny, just like her.
The birds were getting ready to fly south, where it was warm.
Turtle held the middle tightly in his mouth.
He crawled into a pond and swam to the bottom. There he dug a hole in the mud and slept all winter.
Spring came, and Turtle woke up. Now he saw the cracks on his shell, and he felt proud of them.
A black fly buzzed around the man’s face.
As she jumped, she kicked a sleeping crocodile under the tree.
The startled monkey dropped his fruit.
The bushfowl stayed beside her broken eggs and cried.
The lion gathered everyone to hear what had happened.
The bushfowl heard that the fly had been punished. She agreed to call the sun again.
Three little pigs lived with Mama Pig. One day, she told them they were grown and ready to live on their own.
The first little pig built a house from straw.
The third little pig chose bricks for his house.
“Then I’ll huff, and I’ll puff!” said the wolf. He blew the straw house down.
The two little pigs ran to their brother’s brick house.
Down the chimney fell the wolf, right into a pot of hot water! He jumped straight out and ran away.
